# Introduction

This study investigates whether book genre is associated with book color in a fictional books dataset.

# Literature Review

Book cover colors may reflect genre conventions and visual communication strategies that help readers recognize different types of books.

# Method

```{python}
# Import libraries
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv("confident_fictional_books.csv")

# Select variables and remove missing values
df = df[["book_genre", "book_color"]].dropna()

# Display first five observations
print(df.head())

# Number of observations
n = len(df)
```

Using `{python} n` fictional book records, a Chi-square test of independence examines the relationship between genre and color under the null hypothesis that these variables are independent.

# Results

```{python}
# Create contingency table
contingency_table = pd.crosstab(
    df["book_genre"],
    df["book_color"]
)

print("Observed Frequencies:")
print(contingency_table)

# Chi-square test of independence
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(
    contingency_table
)

# Format p-value
p_text = "p < .001" if p < 0.001 else f"p = {p:.3f}"

# Check expected frequencies
print("Minimum expected frequency:", expected.min())

# Display results
print(f"Chi-square statistic: {chi2:.2f}")
print(f"Degrees of freedom: {dof}")
print(p_text)
```

The Chi-square test found `{python} "a statistically significant" if p < 0.05 else "no statistically significant"` association between book genre and book color, χ²(`{python} dof`) = `{python} f"{chi2:.2f}"`, `{python} p_text`.

```{python}
# Visualize observed frequencies
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))

sns.heatmap(
    contingency_table,
    annot=True,
    fmt="d",
    cmap="YlGnBu"
)

plt.title("Book Genre and Book Color")
plt.xlabel("Book Color")
plt.ylabel("Book Genre")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Discussion

The findings `{python} "suggest an association" if p < 0.05 else "do not provide sufficient evidence of an association"` between book genre and color within this fictional dataset, although the results cannot be generalized to real-world publishing practices.
